You are not completely out of luck! According to `03-final-sale-and-promotions.md` under **Damaged or incorrect items** and `01-returns-policy-current.md` under **Exclusions and exceptions**, the final-sale restriction only prevents change-of-mind returns and does not remove your right to report an item that arrived damaged, defective, or incorrect. 

Additionally, as noted in `04-damaged-or-wrong-items.md` under **Final-sale items**, final-sale items remain eligible for review when they arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect. Please note that a refund or replacement cannot be promised before a human review is completed. Because review is required, I recommend reaching out to human support so your case can be reviewed.
